entities.name: Talish-Mughan culture

entities.summary: The Mughan culture or the Talish-Mughan culture is an archeological culture of the late Bronze Age and the early Iron Age epoch in the Mughan plain and the Talysh Mountains in northwest Iran and Southeast Azerbaijan.
